rows.case: false actual value: a runner record with status PASS whose actual says exit 0 while the retained exit file and result.json say 20
missing result: one id of the file has no record
duplicate id: two records carry one id (in one job, and separately across jobs)
unexpected id: a record whose id is not in the file
unauthorized NOT RUN: a row allowing only PASS reported NOT RUN with a reason
weak runner predicate: A1r recorded PASS with a truthful actual (lint problems nonempty) while the retained result has no record-invalid item for the rule file
expectation row with no requirement: requirements empty, or naming an id absent from r6
requirement with no control: an r6 requirement whose control list is empty or names an id absent from the file
raw evidence missing: a PASS record whose manifest names a result.json absent from the evidence set, or whose sha256 differs
procedural predicate failed: SW1 tuples with one site carrying two new FAIL items while the runner records PASS
released NOT RUN: RT-L2 reported NOT RUN while its release check holds
composite incomplete: S11-2 with S11-2c missing
RT-L2 drafted record: the run uses an unreviewed reconciliation record (drift state unresolved)
RT-L2 record bound to another M: reviewed record whose M blob differs from the run M
RT-L2 partial coverage: reviewed bound record covering one of two drifted paths
reference difference: RT-T0 with region_lines.count 214 against reference 215, every expect field met
malformed expectation file: unknown schema id, unknown field, or NOT RUN allowed without reason and release condition
positive control: complete, correct records and evidence for a fixture with one row of each predicate kind and one allowed NOT RUN
RT-L2 reconciled: reviewed record bound to the exact H, M and C blobs covering every drifted path
status/actual inconsistency: runner status FAIL with an actual that meets expect
